notes.title: Announcing Aphelion, DON'T NOD’s new sci-fi adventure!
notes.content: [p]We’re thrilled to present [i]Aphelion[/i], DON’T NOD’s newly announced sci-fi action-adventure game!  [/p][p]Set in a near-future where Earth faces collapse, [i]Aphelion[/i] is an emotional journey to the edge of our Solar System to survey a planet that may be humanity’s last hope. Our latest tale follows two European Space Agency astronauts: Ariane Montclair and Thomas Cross. Following their crash landing on the uncharted planet Persephone, they must brave harsh landscapes, master survival tools, gather crucial information, and navigate reality-bending phenomena in a desperate mission to reunite. [/p][p][/p][p]Check out the reveal trailer:  [/p][previewyoutube="GqvbEVNTcPo;full"][/previewyoutube][p][i]Aphelion[/i] blends our signature emotional storytelling with immersive exploration and traversal, mystery, and tense stealth gameplay. What begins as a totally compromised mission becomes an adventure into the unknown. As you explore the frozen world of Persephone, you’ll gather information on the planet’s strange conditions and what could’ve caused the crash of Ariane and Thomas’s ship, the Hope 01. [/p][p][b]A game in collaboration with the European Space Agency[/b] [/p][p]We’re also super honored to announce that the game is developed in collaboration with the European Space Agency (ESA)! Ariane and Thomas are both ESA astronauts, part of the fictional Hope 01 mission to survey a new potential home for humanity. We’re grounding our depiction of space exploration in real scientific knowledge and humanistic values. This very cool collaboration weaves authentic elements of space science into the emotional core of the game.  [/p][p]After all, this isn’t just a game about a planet. It’s a very human tale of how we behave when all hope is lost, and what keeps us going. [/p][p][i]Aphelion[/i] will launch in 2026 but you can wishlist it right now! [/p][p]To keep up with news on the game, follow us on [url="https://twitter.com/DONTNOD_Ent"][u]X[/u][/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/dontnod_ent/"][u]Instagram[/u][/url] and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@dont_nod"][u]TikTok[/u][/url]! [/p]

notes.title: Announcing The Lonesome Guild, Coming This Fall!
notes.content:
We’re so pleased to announce The Lonesome Guild, a top-down single-player ARPG coming out of Turin, Italy’s Tiny Bull Studios. Announced exclusively at the ID@Xbox IGN FanFest, it’s the next game to be published by DON’T NOD and will release later this year!  

The Lonesome Guild is a tale of friendship, hope, and the strength found in togetherness. In a world consumed by loneliness, only friendship can save the day. Lead a quirky cast in this colorful ARPG full of heart, battles, and bonds that change everything. 

[previewyoutube=dQWc-2nEqNE;full]https://youtu.be/dQWc-2nEqNE [/previewyoutube]

You’ll play as Ghost, a spirit with no memories, in a world consumed by loneliness. As a creeping mist spreads, corrupting all in its path, you must gather a ragtag party of six misfits, each with unique abilities, stories, and struggles. Seamlessly switch between them in battle and exploration, forging bonds that unlock powerful combos and heartfelt moments by the campfire. Enjoy dynamic combat, puzzle-solving, and a world brimming with secrets. 

You can wishlist it now: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1486450/The_Lonesome_Guild/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1486450/The_Lonesome_Guild/ [/url]

notes.title: Presenting the Silent Heroes Bundle in partnership with 11 bit studios
notes.content:
[b]DON’T NOD is happy to be collaborating with 11 bit studios on the Silent Heroes Bundle on Steam[/b], which features[b] both Gerda: A Flame in Winter and This War of Mine in one package[/b]. Now players can experience two intense, emotional stories about civilians during wartime at a discounted price. If you already own one of the games – no worries! You can still buy the bundle and get whichever game you’re missing at a lower price. 

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/35670/Silent_Heroes_Bundle/] Get the Silent Heroes Bundle[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/35670/Silent_Heroes_Bundle/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41650513/22151122664a1188ed1812fdffd2bb193267ad31.png[/img][/url]

We’re proud to have Gerda: A Flame in Winter, developed by Bird Island, stand alongside such a classic as This War of Mine to continue our goal of [b]sharing untold civilian stories[/b]. Both games offer very different experiences while both exploring the struggles, the resilience, and the undying hope of citizens in conflict areas. 

[b]This War of Mine is a critically acclaimed game[/b] in which players attempt to keep a group of civilians alive and safe in a besieged city. Gerda: A Flame in Winter is a story-rich RPG-lite that follows a desperate nurse trying to save her husband from the Gestapo. 

Lives are on the line in both games and your decisions are critical for yourself and your community. Experience two beautifully written, emotional games in the Silent Heroes Bundle.

notes.title: We are partnering with the Danish Refugee Council!
notes.content:
In celebration of [b]Gerda: A Flame in Winter’s first anniversary[/b], [b]we are happy to be collaborating with the Danish Refugee Council[/b]. We have launched a [b]charity edition[/b] of the game’s soundtrack on Steam, the sales of which will help DRC in assisting refugees and the displaced, protecting their rights, and empowering them towards a better future. 

All proceeds will go directly to the Danish Refugee Council. 
 
DRC’s mission and values resonate heavily with us at DON’T NOD and Bird Island. We made Gerda: A Flame in Winter because we wanted to shine a light on how war affects the civilians caught in it, and to encourage the sharing of testimonies so that we may learn from history. 

 
You can support the Danish Refugee Council by purchasing the charity soundtrack here on Steam or you can donate to them directly. 
 
If you’d like to know more about DRC, [url=https://www.drc.ngo/]click here[/url].

notes.title: DON’T NOD is partnering with War Child!
notes.content:
The Gerda: A Flame in Winter – War Child Charity Digital Edition is available now here on Steam to commemorate Day of the Girl, which is a campaign focused on bringing awareness to the issues that girls and young women in war zones face around the world, to advocate strongly for their human rights, and to raise crucial funding to support them.  

This new edition of the game contains: 
[list]
[*] Gerda: A Flame in Winter (full game) 
[*] The original soundtrack composed by Jakob Støvring Hansen 
[*] Six exclusive digital paintings of game environments.   
[/list]

[b]20% of proceeds of the Gerda: A Flame in Winter – War Child Charity Digital Edition will go directly to War Child. [/b]

This partnership is important and a natural step for DON’T NOD and the developers, PortaPlay. Gerda: A Flame in Winter was created to shine a light on one young woman’s experiences in occupied Denmark during World War II. As you may know, the story of Gerda Larsen—our main character—was inspired by a real person, the grandmother of PortaPlay’s CEO and Creative Director, Hans Von Knut Skovfoged. The Gerda: A Flame in Winter – War Child Charity Digital Edition is part of our contribution to War Child’s work in helping civilian children and young people in conflict areas.  

You can support War Child by purchasing the Gerda: A Flame in Winter – War Child Charity Digital Edition or you can donate to them [url=https://donate.warchild.org.uk/]directly[/url]. 

If you’d like to know more about War Child’s Day of the Girl initiative, click [url=https://www.warchild.org.uk/day-of-the-girl-2022]here[/url]. 


Since Gerda: A Flame in Winter’s release around one month ago, there have been some fantastic reviews from media outlets and players alike, so see what the critics have to say in this new accolades trailer.

notes.title: Gerda: A Flame in Winter gameplay overview trailer revealed!
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5zvycnuz6cg

[b] With almost a month to go until the release of Gerda: A Flame in Winter on September 1, we’ve released a gameplay trailer to give you a first look at exploration, choices, and the RPG-lite elements of the game and how those choices—and their direct and indirect consequences—can open different paths to be explored. [/b]

The decisions that you will make as Gerda throughout the game will affect the bonds she already has with her community, as well as the relationships she can make or break with members of the resistance and the occupation.  

You will use her diary to track her progress and the management of her resources and relationships. Also shown in the diary are her ‘mental energies’, the mental skill points she can gain and lose during conversations and confrontations. 

The RPG-lite mechanics are a good way to show that your actions can not only have short-term consequences, but also affect the longer-term course of the story.  

Will there be consequences if you, as a nurse, help a person who is suffering even though they may cause suffering to others? Will you find yourself in a pinch later, if you give away precious resources to somebody who needs them?   


[b] Save the date – Gerda: A Flame in Winter releases on September 1, 2022, and you can wishlist it right now so you don’t forget! [/b]
